summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): Serato DJ Lite.
identityNotes: Research seed with conservative, capability-dependent tests. Exact MIDI IDs, USB IDs, revision, OS support, audio channel maps and tolerance limits are NOT verified; learn or confirm on real hardware before giving pass/fail based on fixed specifications.

documents.title: Manufacturer manual/product documentation
documents.notes: Direct manual for some models; otherwise manufacturer's product/support landing page. Verify exact variant.

documents.title: Firmware, driver and downloads
documents.notes: Check the model-specific download page and operating system.

documents.title: Service manual (public availability not established)
documents.notes: Do not substitute operating instructions for a service manual.

documents.title: MIDI implementation chart (not verified)
documents.notes: Use MIDI Learn or the published mapping; HID events may not appear as MIDI.

specs.label: Candidate hardware functions for diagnostic planning
specs.value: jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb
specs.notes: These category-level capabilities require checking the exact hardware documentation.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on Mixtrack Platinum FX; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact Mixtrack Platinum FX manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Jog display, four-deck control and paddle FX
steps: Check both jog screens and capacitive touch response.
Switch deck layers and verify control of each of four virtual decks.
Test both FX paddles and effect selection, then return to bypass.
